title: GEMS: Generation and Experience Memory for Subgoal-Guided Long-Horizon World Model Planning
description:
arXiv:2611.25134v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Visual world models enable effective short-horizon goal-conditioned planning, such as reaching nearby targets and pushing objects over short distances, by predicting candidate action outcomes and comparing their representations with a goal representation.
